trade_ideas.name: Trend Pullback Long
trade_ideas.thesis: Use pullbacks inside an intact uptrend when price remains in the upper half of its long range.
signal_reasons: Trend stack remains constructive.
Price is close enough to support for a defined stop.
Composite backdrop is +2.3/10.
Relative strength backdrop is -2.75% over 20d.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Price loses the 50 day moving average or medium-term momentum worsens.

trade_ideas.name: Oversold Bounce Long
trade_ideas.thesis: Capture tactical mean reversion after a controlled pullback rather than a full regime break.
signal_reasons: RSI is stretched lower.
Drawdown is moderate rather than catastrophic.
Breadth momentum has room to stabilize.
Tape quality is choppy enough for reversal trades to matter.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Fresh lows keep printing and breadth fails to stabilize.

trade_ideas.name: Breadth Thrust Long
trade_ideas.thesis: Press bullish exposure when participation broadens at the same time price is holding trend support.
signal_reasons: Participation is improving across the universe.
Breadth momentum is positive rather than merely less bad.
Price is not fighting the short-term trend.
Relative strength is confirming the thrust.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Breadth momentum rolls back over and price slips back below the 20 day moving average.

trade_ideas.name: Breakout Continuation Long
trade_ideas.thesis: Lean into compression near highs when volatility is still subdued and a breakout can expand.
signal_reasons: Price is near highs.
Volatility is not yet stretched.
Trend efficiency says the tape is moving directionally.
Relative strength is helping rather than fighting the move.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Breakout fails back below the trigger zone and 20 day support.

trade_ideas.name: Volatility Compression Long
trade_ideas.thesis: Use quiet, tightening conditions near the upper half of the range to prepare for expansion trades.
signal_reasons: Volatility has compressed.
The 20 day average is still sloping higher.
Price is already leaning against the upper half of its range.
Relative strength says the market can lead if expansion arrives.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Volatility expands lower first and price breaks back under the 20 day moving average.

trade_ideas.name: Exhaustion Reversal Short
trade_ideas.thesis: Fade stretched, stalling tape when momentum stops confirming new highs.
signal_reasons: RSI is elevated.
Short-term momentum has rolled over.
Price is extended toward the top of its range.
Relative strength is no longer confirming the headline move.
trade_ideas.invalidation: Momentum re-accelerates higher and price breaks out cleanly to fresh highs.
